authors: Claude (subagent of the main session; draft for the experiment-director card)
question: On the degree-13 Koblitz instance icv1-f2m13-t181-515ee569 (K_0 / F_(2^13), r = 2003), measured in one isolated L2 ecbench session, is the end-to-end S (total group-addition equivalents / sqrt(r)) of binary-subspace[dimension=7] + descent-algebraic[m=2] + fes-f2 + walk below that of the same pipeline with solver inherited-f4, across the AGENTS.md 5a band (0, 0.1, 1 GAE per unpriced native operation), and how far is each from the matched rho?

claims.text: S(ic-descent-fes-f2) < S(ic-descent-inherited-f4) on icv1-f2m13-t181-515ee569: the paired ops ratio fes/inherited from `ecbench compare --a ic-descent-inherited-f4 --b ic-descent-fes-f2` over the 48 (target, round) pairs has its 95 % interval entirely below 1, and the order holds at every band weight (0, 0.1, 1 GAE).
claims.expectation_pre_stated: Ratio about 0.77 (the local, unisolated Run 2 gave 94.7 / 123.1 = 0.77 [pcc:unverified]); interval below 1; order holds across the band.
claims.if_supported: A validated measured improvement of the best algebraic IC row at degree 13 (success criterion: iterative improvement over the index-calculus baseline), eligible for the leaderboard once VALIDATION.json passes; the distance remaining to rho is reported, not a pass/fail.
claims.if_not_supported: Falsified if the 95 % interval of the paired ratio includes or exceeds 1, if the fes-f2 arm's mean S is not below the inherited-f4 arm's at any band weight (order changes inside the band = unresolved, not a win), or if any measured IC run fails to verify. The local Run 2 gain is then not reproduced under isolation and is reported as such.
claims.risk_noted_before_freeze: ecbench band re-prices the pinned solver word XORs at w: at w = 0 the solver is free and the descent arms differ only by the group work of the targets tried (smoke ratio 0.97), so the w = 0 leg of H1 rests on trial counts, not on solver cost.

claims.text: Both solvers are priced on the same basis in the session: decomposition.solver.priced_by is `pinned` (word XORs at the curve's pinned ns_per_word_xor ratio) on every record of both descent arms, and no `solver_*_uncharged` counter appears.
claims.if_not_supported: H1 is not evaluable (one arm's solver work would be removed from the total as unpriced); report the pricing defect, do not rank.

claims.text: Distance remaining: each IC arm's mean S divided by the reference rho's mean S (rho.signed_frobenius_strong_v2, the strongest Koblitz reference) and by rho.negation's (the local 'matched rho' kind, S = 2.76 locally), each at 0, 0.1 and 1 GAE.
claims.if_supported: Reported as the gap to rho.

claims.text: No end-to-end wall-time speedup claim, no claim at other degrees, and no claim about the fes-then-inherited size rule (commit 4840612771, not in the measured source) is in scope.

arms.description: rho.signed_frobenius_strong_v2 (signed-Frobenius orbits, A = 2n): the strongest available Koblitz rho; first reference arm, paired with the A/A control by run-ecbench.
rho.negation (negation map, A = 2, look-ahead and cycle escape): the kind of the local 'matched rho' (S = 2.76).
ic.pipeline binary-subspace:dimension=7 + mitm:m=2 + walk, max_trials 2000000: the pair-table reference IC row.
ic.pipeline binary-subspace:dimension=7 + descent-algebraic:m=2 + solver inherited-f4 + walk, max_trials 2000000, no solver wall budget.
As ic-descent-inherited-f4 with solver fes-f2 (Gray-code exhaustive search over F_2, two word XORs a point).
Identical to rho-sfstrong-v2; A/A noise floor and position-bias control required by run-ecbench (wall.status admitted, aa_pairs >= 5).

sample.why_enough: The local effect is 0.77x with non-overlapping 2-repeat ranges; 48 paired measured runs per arm give a paired-ratio interval far narrower than that gap if the per-run spread is like the local one (83.7-105.7 vs 117.8-128.4). Fixed N, no sequential stopping.
sample.runtime_estimate: Smoke: 36 executions in 3 s plus replay-all under 1 s locally; full spec 336 executions, about 30 s of ecbench run, replay-all well under a minute; pod total dominated by provisioning (2-5 min), the harness's fixed 60 s sleep and S3 upload. Deadline 1800 s.

stopping_rule: Fixed N: one session, the spec as frozen. No reruns to obtain a pass; a failed or censored run stays in the record. A Spot loss is a charged failed attempt; any re-submission is a new labelled attempt under the same protocol and budget.

amendments_before_freeze.text: Local smoke (smoke/, reduced spec: 2 targets, 2 rounds) used the full spec's target_seed and measurement.seed, so 4 of the 48 measured pairs per arm (workloads W06626ec90423 and W36123866dc8d, rounds 1-2) were seen before the freeze: paired fes/inherited GAE ratios 0.75, 0.43, 0.73, 0.70; band order fes < inherited at w = 0, 0.1, 1 with w = 0 ratio 0.97. Counted S is deterministic, so these 4 pairs will recur identically in the isolated session. The full spec was not run locally. The main session may choose fresh seeds before freezing; that is a design choice recorded here, not a change after data.

Main session: fresh seeds for the frozen spec (target_seed 248600354536533 -> 24899570366495, measurement seed 51364757418560 -> 171474876352264, derived from the '/a1/' tags), so no measured pair was seen in the smoke. H1 keeps the repository rule (AGENTS.md §5a): fes-f2 is ranked below inherited-f4 only if the order holds at w = 0, 0.1 and 1; at w = 0 the solver is free and the arms differ by targets tried only, so an order change there is reported as 'unresolved inside the band', not as a win or a loss. Reference rho is signed-Frobenius strong v2 (strongest Koblitz rho); negation-map rho is kept as a baseline that reproduces the local 2.76.
